content:

The idea would be to have a more realistic network than the benhcmarking we are doing (a CL running together with EL, mainnet style loads, syncing, BD compaction, etc.)

Do you have an opinion of what the right way to do this would be? If we were already planning on launching such a devnet, would it make sense to do it earlier so we can uncover issues in time for the testnets?
